title: Package manager config
description: Configuration listing installed repos and the build types used to build them.

buildTypes.description: Known build types, matched by the presence of a file in the repo.

name.description: Short name of the repo; also the binary name used in install/uninstall.

buildType.description: The build type selected for this repo, with <name> already substituted.

version.description: Installed git commit SHA (may include a trailing newline).

fileName.description: File whose presence in the repo identifies this build type (e.g. go.mod, Makefile).

build.description: Shell command that builds the project.

install.description: Shell command that installs the built binary. <name> is a placeholder for the repo name in buildTypes templates.

uninstall.description: Shell command that removes the installed binary. <name> is a placeholder for the repo name in buildTypes templates.
